site_tpl.backup_failed: The previous site wasn’t saved to {dir}: {err}
site_tpl.bad_id: “{tid}” is not a template id from the catalog: Latin letters, digits, “_”, “-”, “.”.
site_tpl.catalog.damaged: The site template catalog on this server is damaged — it has to be downloaded again.
site_tpl.catalog.index_not_built: The site template catalog index wasn’t built — open the list again; if that doesn’t help, update Kaskad ({hint}).
site_tpl.catalog.missing: This server doesn’t have the site template catalog yet: it is downloaded when the site is turned on (a GitHub key is needed).
site_tpl.catalog.unreadable: The site template catalog can’t be read — it has to be downloaded again.
site_tpl.fetch.bad_key: GitHub rejected the key (response {code}) — the site template catalog wasn’t downloaded. Check the GitHub key ({hint}) and try again.
site_tpl.fetch.missing: Site template catalog not found (branches {refs}). Update Kaskad ({hint}) and try again; if Kaskad was installed from another branch, put it in /etc/kaskad/config: KASKAD_BRANCH="name".
site_tpl.fetch.net: GitHub didn’t return the site template catalog — try again in a few minutes.
site_tpl.fetch.no_key: The site template catalog is in Kaskad’s private repository and can’t be downloaded without a GitHub key. Set the key ({hint}) and try again.
site_tpl.fetch.no_net: No connection to GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com) — the site template catalog wasn’t downloaded. Check the server’s internet connection and try again.
site_tpl.fetch.sha: The downloaded site template catalog failed verification (checksum mismatch) and wasn’t saved. Update Kaskad and try again.
site_tpl.fs: Template “{tid}” wasn’t put in {root}: {err}. The previous site is untouched.
site_tpl.health.gone: removed by its author — can’t be chosen
site_tpl.health.no_preview: preview taken down, the template installs
site_tpl.help.category: category (an id from the list of categories)
site_tpl.help.check: check whether the templates of the page are still there (repository and preview; up to 40 s)
site_tpl.help.fetch: fetch the catalog first if it’s missing
site_tpl.help.index: build the template catalog index (the panel and the bot run this themselves, as a separate process)
site_tpl.help.query: a word from the name or description
site_tpl.help.random: a random template (no portfolios or personal pages)
site_tpl.help.set: install a template from the catalog (the previous site goes to a backup)
site_tpl.help.templates: site template catalog: categories, search, pages of 25
site_tpl.index.built: Site template catalog index built: {n} templates, {cats} categories.
site_tpl.index.failed: The site template catalog index wasn’t built (code {rc}){tail}. Try again; if that doesn’t help, update Kaskad ({hint}).
site_tpl.index.fresh: Site template catalog index is up to date: {n} templates, {cats} categories.
site_tpl.list.catalog: Site template catalog: {n} templates under free licenses.
site_tpl.list.head: {head} — {n} found, page {page} of {pages}
site_tpl.list.how: Category list: kaskadctl site templates --category landing · search: --query cafe
site_tpl.locked: The site template is already being changed (in another window, the panel or the bot) — wait for it to finish and try again.
site_tpl.log.catalog_github: SITE: template catalog downloaded from GitHub (branch {ref})
site_tpl.log.git: SITE: git installed for site templates
site_tpl.log.gone: SITE: template {tid} was removed by its author — not installed
site_tpl.log.gone_next: SITE: template {tid} was removed by its author — taking another one
site_tpl.log.stub: SITE: no template deployed — a placeholder page put in {root}
site_tpl.low_disk: Not enough disk space to download the site template (at least {mb} MB free is needed). Free up space and try again.
site_tpl.root.bad: Site directory “{root}” won’t do: a separate directory like {example} is needed.
site_tpl.root.symlink: Site directory {root} is a symbolic link; Kaskad doesn’t touch it. Remove the link and try again.
site_tpl.set.backup: The previous site is saved in {path}.
site_tpl.set.failed: Template not installed: {text} The previous site is untouched.
site_tpl.set.fallback: No template from GitHub deployed — a placeholder page is put in so the site isn’t empty.
site_tpl.set.later: Choose a template later: kaskadctl site template set --random
site_tpl.set.thanks: Thanks to {author} for the open source code.
site_tpl.status.empty: The site isn’t deployed yet ({root} is empty).
site_tpl.status.own: {root} holds a custom site — not from the Kaskad catalog.
site_tpl.status.stub: The site has a placeholder page ({root}). Install a template: kaskadctl site template set --random
site_tpl.text.app_shell: Template “{tid}” is an app shell with no content — the browser would show a blank screen.
site_tpl.text.bad_repo: Template “{tid}” has an invalid repository address in the catalog — choose another one.
site_tpl.text.broken_assets: In template “{tid}” the page refers to styles and scripts that are not in the repository.
site_tpl.text.download_failed: Template “{tid}” didn’t download: the repository is unavailable or there is no connection to GitHub.
site_tpl.text.gone: Template “{tid}” was removed by its author — choose another one.
site_tpl.text.no_index: Template “{tid}” has no ready index.html page — the repository holds sources to build, not a site.
site_tpl.text.timeout: Template “{tid}” didn’t download in {sec} seconds: GitHub is slow or the repository is too big.
site_tpl.text.too_big: Template “{tid}” is over {mb} MB — too much for a masking site, choose another one.
site_tpl.text.unknown_template: Template “{tid}” is not in the catalog.
site_tpl.unknown_category: No category “{category}” in the catalog. Categories: {categories}.
